items.caption: A modern redraw of 了 in Shuowen seal-script style. It shows the received dictionary form, not a dated artifact or a settled interpretation of the graph.
items.alt: Black seal-style form of 了, with a rounded upper loop and a long descending stroke.
items.selection_reason: This identified redraw helps readers see the received seal-script form discussed in the entry. It cannot establish what the graph originally depicted.

limitations.text: The received Shuowen account relates 了 to 子 without arms, while later commentary reads the form as crossed or entangled legs. This redraw does not resolve those competing interpretations or establish a dated graphic history.
